messages.content: What was the full name king of England in 1800?

function.name: monarch_getMonarchOfYear
function.description: Retrieve the monarch of a specific location during a specified year. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location (e.g., country) whose monarch needs to be found.

year.description: The year to search the monarch.

fullName.description: If true, returns the full name and title of the monarch.

message.reasoning:
We need to answer "What was the full name king of England in 1800?" They want the full name of the King of England in 1800.

In 1800, the monarch was George III. Full name: George William Frederick Ernest Augustus Henry Philip Louis. Actually his full name: George William Frederick Ernest Augustus Henry Philip Louis. He reigned from 1760 until 1820 as King of Great Britain and Ireland; after Act of Union 1707 he was also King of England etc. So we can provide that.

But maybe they expect using tool to retrieve data. We have a function `monarch_getMonarchOfYear` which takes location and year. Let's call it with location="England" or "United Kingdom"? But question says "king of England". In 1800 there was no separate monarchy of England; it's part of United Kingdom. However historically still called King of England. We'll use location="England", year=1800. Provide fullName=true. Then output result.

Let's do so.
